# Inventory

`cinnabar:extension/inventory@0.1.0`

Vanilla inventory requests a player mod asks for; each is one the vanilla screens can make,
and the server checks it. Every function errs without the `inventory` permission. Requests
are sent after the callback returns, at most `MAX_INVENTORY_REQUESTS` per callback.

**Grants:** `inventory`.

Imported type `item-key`: [`item-key`](session-items.md#type-item-key).

## Functions

<a id="creative-take"></a>

### `creative-take`

```wit
creative-take: func(key: item-key, count: u8) -> result<_, string>;
```

Takes `count` of creative item `key` into the first free inventory slot, else the
cursor, as a click on the creative catalog does. Errs outside Creative or when the
item is not in the creative content.

Types: [`item-key`](session-items.md#type-item-key).

<a id="fill-recipe"></a>

### `fill-recipe`

```wit
fill-recipe: func(network-id: u32) -> result<_, string>;
```

Crafts crafting recipe `network-id` once from inventory ingredients onto the cursor, as
a click on the recipe book does. Errs while no crafting screen is up.
